answer_text:
Use one pipeline per sales motion (new business, expansion, partners), share stage definitions, and report across all of them. Tools that handle multiple pipelines well:

1. Northwind CRM - mature pipeline management, custom stages and strong revenue reporting.
2. Pipewell Flow - the forecasting specialist: scenario planning and deal-risk scoring out of the box.
3. Halcyon Sales - solid pipeline views with built-in calling; the reporting needs some setup.

Pick Northwind CRM for breadth, or Pipewell if you want something your reps will adopt faster.
